name: nullable-dimension-filters
description: Exercise null maps, nullable projection counting and selective group reductions

queries.name: nulls
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE coupon IS NULL

queries.name: nonnull-by-region
queries.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE coupon IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

queries.name: paid-noncoupon
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE coupon IS NULL AND status = 'paid'

queries.name: promo-revenue
queries.sql: SELECT category, SUM(amount) FROM events WHERE coupon IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
